module_summary: Three-state Moore FSM computing serial two's complement of LSB-first input x, outputting z when in state C.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: A/B/C state register with async reset; tracks whether first 1 has been seen

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Serial complemented output bit decoded from state C

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Serial LSB-first input bit steering every state transition

groups.name: twos_complement_fsm
groups.description: Moore machine passing bits until first 1, then inverting
